summary: Add a production-mounted Fractal App Storybook with deterministic schema-decoded scenarios, light/dark width matrices, working development HMR and lazy-inclusive bidirectional App identity gates with planted-copy controls.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of stored data.

schema.detail: No new wire or storage schema; fixtures decode with the production client codecs.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Development-only app book and fixture adapter; production component implementations, transport, public protocol and app CSP are unchanged. Only Storybook excludes the app-document CSP plugin. Storybook dependencies match the kit at 10.6.1. The initial corpus contains three authored sessions; availability labels are not additional sessions.

manual.detail: Run pnpm --filter fractal-web storybook for local review, or build-storybook before the kit composition build.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover; generated storybook-static output is not committed.
